text:
maya: Quick midday async — what I did / blockers / today

maya: Did final copy pass for the benchmark blog, uploaded assets to GCS. Found a couple of CTA variants that need legal review (pinged @sophia). :sparkles:

alex: LGTM on copy, saw the CTA notes. I can address the minor markup fixes. No blockers from eng side.

chris: Bench numbers from last night: 90th perc latency down 12% after batching tweak. Raw csv in the drive: https://go.redwood/bench/2005. Will post a short summary later.

maya: Nice, thanks chris. That latency change helps for the launch SLO. Can you add 1-2 sentence blurb for the blog?

chris: yep, will add.

jordan: Quick heads-up — CDN purge for the staging assets is queued. deploy-bot said the canary passed at 09:12.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed for content assets (canary-id: can-2005). No errors. :white_check_mark:

alex: I have a small PR open for the microcopy tweak (PR #412). Need one more reviewer. @maya or @sophia can you take a look when free?

maya: On it, reviewing now.

sophia: Reviewing CTA language, will leave comments. Legal flagged one phrase — suggest: change "enterprise-ready" to "suitable for enterprise use". Not a blocker, just wording.

maya: good call. I'll update the copy and push a new commit.

chris: For the bench blurb: short draft — "Applied dynamic batching and prefix caching; observed 12% reduction in tail latency with no throughput regression." Anyone want different wording?

alex: That reads fine. Maybe add a token-cost note: "~3% token-cost improvement" if that checks out.

chris: I'll verify cost delta and include if stable.

maya: Today I'm finalizing the launch checklist, syncing with growth later today at 3pm PT. Blocker: waiting on final legal ok for the CTAs — once that's in, we schedule the publish window.

jordan: From infra: if we publish between 2–4pm PT, we recommend a short throttle step to warm caches, otherwise spikes might cause higher miss rates.

maya: noted. We'll aim for 3:15pm PT then.

alex: Quick question — do we want a fallback copy path if legal doesn't sign off by 2pm? I can stage the alternate assets behind a flag.

maya: Yes please, Alex. Flag approach good. Put the alternate assets in /staging/fallback and tag the PR with "fallback-ready".

alex: Will do. PR updated.

sophia: Legal aims to finish by 1:30pm PT. If any delays, I'll ping here immediately.

maya: Perfect. Thanks team — short check-in later after the growth sync with publish decision. :rocket:
